name: RobotAtlas
summary:
Explore published robot models in 3D.

Robot Atlas is an independent visualization app by Nebulytic for Meta Quest 3. Browse 71 models grouped by source company, then inspect one on a movable glass base. Resize the rack, toolbar and model to suit your space.

Choose passthrough, Studio or Black. Switch between full source colour, colour hologram, blue hologram, see-through and exploded assembly views. Exploded view separates only the parts actually included in a source; it does not reveal missing geometry.
